facebook.caption:
2,585 reviews. 4.7 stars. This beef spot on Trần Hưng Đạo is not a secret anymore, and honestly it deserves every single one.

Bò Tơ Quán Đảo Phú Quốc serves young beef (bò tơ) done the Phu Quoc way. Tender, smoky, zero fuss. $15-30 a person for a full table spread.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
